scope: read-only source and metadata audit; no numerical imports, NPZ parsing, provider, primitive, solver, or tests

api_review.successful_path_evidence_contract: 16 query rows, 16 QP H+/H-/J records, six rigid modes, baseline/final point ledgers, at most 3 assemblies and 1 KKT solve

limitations.external_watchdog_required: inner total_seconds_from_preflight is sampled at child return; external watchdog must time entire outer process including post-pins and receipt serialization and reject elapsed > 60 s
limitations.memory: 64 MiB is an estimated working-memory gate, not measured RSS
limitations.partial_qp_failure: interface_qps is assigned only after the full loop; a NOT_ACCEPTED loop failure may leave zero without implying no partial constructions; accept only complete 16-row successful ledger
limitations.metadata_json: supervisor disabled-state and lock metadata dumps omit allow_nan=False but contain only fixed strings/bools and finite PID/time metadata
limitations.physical_scope: toy fixed-crack Mode-I elastic cohesive diagnostic only; material calibration, process-zone, mixed-mode, and growth remain unqualified
